name: John A. Knauss
summary: Seagoing oceanographer, educator, and government administrator known for Pacific Equatorial Undercurrent measurements and NOAA leadership.

name: M. Susan Lozier
summary: Oceanographer and president of The Oceanography Society who authored this tribute.

name: University of Rhode Island
summary: University where Knauss served as founding dean of the Graduate School of Oceanography.

name: Scripps Institution of Oceanography
summary: Institution where Knauss completed graduate study and measured the Pacific Equatorial Undercurrent.

name: National Sea Grant Program
summary: Federal program Knauss helped form in 1966 to support marine research and education.

name: Stratton Commission
summary: Congressional commission authorized in 1966 to recommend marine environment policy.

name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
summary: US agency created following Stratton Commission recommendations, led by Knauss from 1989 to 1993.

name: Department of Commerce
summary: US Department where Knauss served as Under Secretary for Oceans and Atmosphere.

name: American Geophysical Union
summary: Scientific union that awarded Knauss an Ocean Sciences Award and fellowship.

name: American Association for the Advancement of Science
summary: Scientific society that granted Knauss fellowship.

name: Oceanography
summary: Quarterly journal of The Oceanography Society where this tribute was published.

name: John A. Knauss Marine Policy Fellowships
summary: Fellowship program named in Knauss's honor established in 1979.

name: Law of the Sea Treaty
summary: International treaty negotiated in the 1970s and adopted in 1982.
